Known gaps of the OPf_PARENS check: a paren on an op perl folds or
optimises away. A folded op carries no P bit, so psc's Paren on that node
has no counterpart; perigrin's ruling (2026-10-23, chain-review round 6,
F15) makes it a gap, never a defect, and canon writes the paren.

Each row is a fixture, as in fixtures.txt, with a `--- gap` section: the
`LINE OP` psc's Paren maps to, which perl folded away. The check re-runs
the pinned perl on the snippet and requires that op to be absent from the
statement's ops, or one of that name to carry FOLD, or every one of that
name to be a nulled op without P that a multideref on the line absorbed;
a row that perl still emits present and unfolded fails.

A `--- perl-gap` section is the converse: a P bit a fold gave an op no
source paren stands for. The check requires perl to still mark it P.

`#` lines quote perl 5.44.0's Concise, the evidence of the fold.

=== a parenthesised hash key
my %h;
my $v = $h{(1)};
--- perl
none
--- gap
2 const
# 5           <+> multideref($h{"1"}) sK ->6: the key's const is folded
# into the multideref, and no op carries P

=== a negated parenthesised constant
my $v = -(1);
--- perl
none
--- gap
1 const
# 3        <$> const[IV -1] s/FOLD ->4

=== a concatenation with a parenthesised constant
my $v = "a" . ("b");
--- perl
none
--- gap
1 const
# 3        <$> const[PV "ab"] s/FOLD ->4

=== a parenthesised element before an arrow subscript
sub g {
  my $v = ($_[0])->[0];
}
--- perl
none
--- gap
2 ex-aelem
# -           <1> ex-aelem sK/2 ->3
# 2              <+> multideref($_[0][0]) sK ->3: the aelem is nulled
# into the multideref, and no op carries P

=== not over a doubly parenthesised constant
my $r = not((1));
--- perl
none
--- gap
1 const
# 3        <$> const[SPECIAL sv_no] s/FOLD ->4: not's pair is SyntaxParen,
# the inner pair the 1's Paren, and the not folded with it

=== a list slice by a constant range
my @a;
my @r = (@a)[0..1];
--- perl
2 rv2av
--- perl-gap
2 rv2av
# 8                 <1> rv2av lKP/1 ->9
# 7                    <$> const[AV ARRAY] s ->8: the range 0..1 folded
# into a constant array, whose rv2av carries P with no source paren
